Lifemark is a proudly Canadian healthcare company, providing a diverse array of services across the country. We have over 20 years of experience providing physiotherapy and rehabilitation, medical assessments, seniors wellness, and sport medicine programs. With highly trained clinicians and medical professionals in over 360 locations coast to coast, we are one of Canada’s most trusted healthcare organizations.

In 2026, Lifemark was recognized by Forbes as one of Canada’s Best Employers for Company Culture, reflecting our commitment to fostering a positive, supportive, and inclusive workplace.

This channel is the place to find videos on health and wellness tips, exercise ideas, and much more! Subscribe to our channel to learn more.
